product_one_liner.value: Lumilens provides silicon-photonic optical interconnects that scale up and scale out AI compute infrastructure for hyperscalers and AI data-center operators.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing or plans link was found on the site; the /pricing URL returned no readable pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The site and launch announcement describe an unnamed hyperscaler customer; searches found no customer case-study or review page establishing two named customers. Investors and technology partners were not treated as customers.

employee_band.notes: The company-size field lists 201–500 employees; the same profile separately reports 164 associated employees, so those two measures differ.

eng_blog.notes: The News & Insights index contains company announcements, interviews and industry/founder perspectives, not two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help portal link was found; docs.lumilens.com and help.lumilens.com returned no readable pages.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable board lists 163 openings, but no qualifying AI, ML, data-science, applied/research-scientist, NLP, LLM or computer-vision title. The data software-engineering role is excluded.

model_provider.notes: No publicly named model/provider was found in the product and manufacturing pages, News & Insights, or privacy policy. No public docs, AI/security FAQ, trust center or subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: The public privacy/legal page names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as a claimed certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 6, 2026. The reported round was MORE THAN US$700 million; the numeric amount is the published threshold, not an exact total. More than US$900 million is cumulative funding, not this round.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 financing falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account-executive title appears in the readable 163-opening board.

launched_6mo.notes: On August 6, 2026, Lumilens emerged from stealth and announced its first product was commercially shipping into production AI data centers; this falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Neera Patel’s profile lists Chief Financial Officer at Lumilens from October 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Business Process Manager posting explicitly names CRM (Salesforce) and Salesforce automation tooling. This is a job-post stack signal, not independent confirmation of a deployed instance; other named tools are ERP, ITSM, PLM or automation rather than CRM/marketing platforms.
